# PremierConnect AI

> AI search visibility (AEO and GEO) and AI agent teams for businesses. Founded by Demetri Panagiotou, Austin, Texas, working with businesses anywhere. Every engagement starts with a free expert audit.

## Services
- Free expert AI audit: tests how ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity answer the questions your customers ask, reviews what AI can read about your business, and maps where AI agents can work 24/7. Written report included.
- AEO and GEO: make your site easy for AI to read, publish plain answers to customer questions, fix listings, re-test monthly.
- AI agent teams: lead intake, follow-up, scheduling and reminders, records that stay current. A person approves anything sent to a customer.

## Pricing
- Free expert audit. Monthly plans: Starter $500, Growth $1,000, Scale $2,000.

## Systems we built and run
- Email outreach agent, AI content team, AEO and GEO audit agent, live SMS agent, custom CRM.
